pages.text: Ten gems can be cut at a crafting table, each a plus of one material: $(item)diamond$(), $(item)redstone$(), $(item)lapis$(), $(item)emerald$(), $(item)quartz$(), $(item)amethyst$(), $(item)prismarine$(), $(item)glowstone$(), $(item)copper$() and $(item)ender pearl$().$(br2)Each holds two of the eleven patterns.
